# wall_correction_validity_floor@v1

The lowest bead-centre height at which the parallel wall correction's series is as accurate as its source states.

- **Kind:** `bound`, side effect `none`.
- **Bounds:** `bead_centre_height`, side `min`.
- **Applies to:** observables `trapped_particle_drag_coefficient` on `transmitted`.
- **State:** planned: its code and a running case have not landed, so no run can use it.

## Inputs

| input | unit | obtained by | what it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bead_radius` | um | source | radius of the trapped bead |
| `wall_series_validity_ratio` | 1 | source | the centre-height-to-radius ratio above which the source states the series is accurate, taken from the source's entry and never written into the code |

A missing input refuses the run before any code runs, and the run sheet says how the input is obtained. Never fill one with an estimate of your own.

## Outputs

- `bead_centre_height_min` (um): the ratio times the radius

## Source

Tolić-Nørrelykke, Schäffer, Howard, Pavone, Jülicher & Flyvbjerg, Rev. Sci. Instrum. 77, 103101 (2006). Appendix D: where the series of Eq. 40 agrees with the exact result, and to what accuracy.

Store entry `wall_drag_parallel_faxen_series`, not pinned yet, because the entry is not in the store.

**Where it holds.** One plane no-slip wall.
